day2_night_phone_1.text: *The old school group chat. 'Read by 3'. Nobody replied. Two days now.*

day2_night_phone_2.text:
*I sent Minsu a message.*

Hey, Minsu. I transferred and you haven't even contacted me.

day2_night_phone_3.text: *10 minutes later. The '...' indicator appeared. Minsu is typing.*

day2_night_phone_4.text: *5 seconds. The typing indicator keeps blinking. Is he writing a long message?*

day2_night_phone_6.text:
*Minsu*

Yeah doing well. How's it there?

day2_night_phone_7.text: *Usually, an emoticon would follow the question mark. This time, there’s nothing.*

day2_night_phone_8.text: *The typing indicator blinks for 5 seconds. The reply isn't even two lines long.*

day2_night_phone_9.text:
*I replied.*

Why so formal? Did something happen?

day2_night_phone_10.text: *1 minute. 2 minutes. The typing indicator appears again.*

day2_night_phone_11.text:
*Minsu*

No. Nothing happened. I was busy.

day2_night_phone_12.text: *Again, none of Minsu’s usual swearing or emojis. All three sentences end with periods.*

day2_night_phone_13.text: *My thumb stayed frozen over the input box for a long time.*
choices: Check the old group chat again
Put the phone down and think

day2_night_ft_messenger.text:
*I sent a reply.*

Hey Minsu, is that really you? This isn't like you. Did something happen?

day2_night_ft_messenger_2.text: *Typing indicator. Blinking forever. Five seconds, ten, twenty.*

day2_night_ft_messenger_3.text:
*Minsu*

It's me. I'm just a little sleepy.

day2_night_ft_messenger_4.text: *The typing indicator that blinked for 20 seconds disappears, leaving just one short message bubble.*

day2_night_ft_messenger_5.text: *I erased the half-written letters in the input box. When I turned the screen off, only my face remained in the black glass.*

day2_night_sea_1.text:
*Sea*

I finished organizing the student council room today.

day2_night_sea_4.text:
*I reply*

See you tomorrow. Good luck getting ready.

day2_night_sea_5.text:
*Sea*

Prepare? You're supposed to help me.

day2_night_sea_6.text:
*Sea*

I'll be waiting again tomorrow morning

day2_night_sea_7.text: You don't have to come early. It's cold.

day2_night_sea_8.text:
*Sea*

I'm not cold. The wind doesn't blow much near the school gate.

day2_night_sea_9_alt.text:
*Sea*

Then I'll see you at school tomorrow. Don't stay up too late.

day2_night_sea_9.text:
*Sea*

But Saturday is still on, right?

day2_night_sea_14.text: *I put the phone down. The moon is out the window. Another KakaoTalk notification buzzes.*

day2_night_sea_14a.text: *A message came through the Student Safety App.*

day2_night_eunsu_1.text:
*Eunsu*

{name}, you did well on your presentation today. You're adapting fast.

day2_night_eunsu_2.text:
*Eunsu*

Can you stop by the teachers' office tomorrow? There's a document I need to check.

day2_night_eunsu_5.text: *The profile photo in the student safety app was blank. Under the sender's name, instead of a phone number, there was only a gray label reading `Homeroom Teacher`.*

day2_night_flash_1.text: *I lie under the covers and close my eyes.*

day2_night_flash_2.text: *An image flashes through my mind. A corridor in this school, rain pouring down. I'm running beside someone in a soaked uniform—*

day2_night_flash_3.text: *Holding hands. A girl's hand. A cold hand.*

day2_night_flash_4.text: *"This way" -- someone's voice. A familiar voice.*

day2_night_flash_5.text: *I open my eyes. There's sweat on my forehead.*

day2_night_flash_6.text: *The room is quiet. But the soles of my feet still held the cold of the wet hallway floor.*

day2_night_flash_7.text: *I touch my shoulder. Where Eunsu patted me this afternoon, I feel the cold of the hand I was just holding, the two sensations overlapping.*

day2_night_flash_8.text: *I can see the transfer papers under the desk lamp. The corner of the page is folded at the same angle as it was this morning.*

day2_night_search_1.text: *I kick off the blanket and sit up. Sleep won't come. I pick up my phone and type 'Haedoji School' into the search bar.*

day2_night_search_2.text: *The official school website has a message from the principal and the school history. The graduation album link says 'Coming soon.' Eunsu and Riin are listed as staff, but neither has a photo.*

day2_night_search_3.text: *News search: 'Haedoji School.' No results. The local news tab is empty too. Only `No documents match your search terms` remains in the center of the screen.*

day2_night_search_4.text: *'Haedoji High festival', 'Haedoji High graduation ceremony'. Autocomplete appears, but there are no results. Only gray rectangles repeat where the thumbnails should be.*

day2_night_search_5.text: *The screen brightness lowered on its own. The school's name is still in the search bar. I set the phone down without deleting it.*

day2_night_dream_1.text: *I close my eyes again. This time, I fall asleep.*

day2_night_dream_3.text: *A classroom. But not the current one. The desk arrangement is different. There's a date written on the blackboard but I can't read it.*

day2_night_dream_4.text: *Someone is sitting in the front seat. Long hair. I can only see their back.*

day2_night_dream_6.text: *That person turns around. It's Seolhwa. In the dream, Seolhwa's eyes are dry. The corners of her mouth are raised.*

day2_night_dream_7.text: *She opens her mouth, but no sound comes out. Only the shape of her lips remains. 'Help—'*

day2_night_dream_7a.text: *Before the next syllable comes out, the date on the blackboard begins to blur.*

day2_night_dream_8.text: *The classroom grows dark. Seolhwa's face blurs.*

day2_night_wake_2.text: *Only Seolhwa's smiling face remains. Her voice is buried beneath the alarm, leaving only the shape of her lips.*

day2_night_wake_3.text: *The phone beside my pillow is still lit. The search bar still reads 'Haedoji School.'*

day2_night_ft_groupchat.text: *I opened the old group chat. The read count beside the last message had not changed.*

day2_night_ft_groupchat_2.text: *I returned to the chat list and tapped Minsu’s name.*

day2_night_ft_putdown.text: *I laid the phone face down and thought again about the three sentences Minsu had sent.*

day2_night_ft_putdown_2.text: *The phone vibrated on the desk. I turned it face up again.*
